image_description: A dark grey/black adult common iguana resting on light-colored stone steps. The iguana is positioned diagonally across the frame, facing right. Its body is robust with a prominent dorsal crest running from the neck down the spine. The skin texture appears scaly and rough. The head features a large dewlap and visible eye. Forelimbs are splayed with visible claws gripping the step edge. The tail extends out of the frame to the left.
